items.title: Continuous Discovery Habits
items.fit: Product team with access to customers, outcome ownership and time for repeated discovery
items.avoid: Treating a single workshop or fictional interviews as continuous discovery
items.output: Opportunity tree, interview insights and tested assumptions

items.title: Opportunity Solution Tree
items.fit: Focused outcome with specified customer and real story-based interview evidence; iterative opportunity, solution and assumption test mapping
items.avoid: Speculative opportunities, company-wide OSTs, or treating the diagram as a validated finding
items.output: Evidence-referenced, revisioned outcome/opportunity/solution/test hierarchy

items.title: SVPG Product Operating Model
items.fit: Cross-functional empowered teams own measurable outcomes
items.avoid: Treating a fixed-scope consulting deliverable as an empowered product team
items.output: Team mandate, decision rights, outcomes, coaching interventions

items.title: Business Model Canvas
items.fit: Expose dependencies among customers, value creation, delivery and economics
items.avoid: Treating a completed canvas as a validated business or universal company model
items.output: Dated hypothesis version of the nine linked blocks

items.title: Value Proposition Canvas
items.fit: Compare specific segment jobs, obstacles and desired gains to an offer
items.avoid: Declaring fit without segment-specific customer evidence
items.output: Segment-specific value map with testable fits

items.title: Strategyzer Test Card
items.fit: State a precise assumption, measurement, threshold and proposed experiment
items.avoid: Experiment with an undefined success threshold
items.output: Hypothesis-linked experimental protocol

items.title: Strategyzer Learning Card
items.fit: Translate experimental observations into explicit learning and resulting actions
items.avoid: Conclusions not grounded in actual observations
items.output: Evidence-linked learning and action record

items.title: JTBD: progress and switching
items.fit: Explain circumstances and forces behind customer choice and switching
items.avoid: Reducing a lived situation to a demographic persona
items.output: Contextual job stories and alternative selection explanations

items.title: JTBD: Outcome-Driven Innovation
items.fit: Quantify desired outcomes for a defined functional job when customer data can be collected
items.avoid: Using invented importance/satisfaction numbers
items.output: Job map and ranked unmet outcome statements

items.title: Wardley Mapping
items.fit: Explore value chains, dependencies, technology evolution and strategic positioning
items.avoid: Presenting weakly grounded evolutionary positions as facts
items.output: Versioned value-chain/evolution map and implications

items.title: Causal Loop / Systems Dynamics
items.fit: Explain feedback, delays, unintended consequences across interacting actors
items.avoid: Assuming speculative causal links are proven or omitting delays
items.output: Causal model, alternate mechanisms, intervention hypotheses

items.title: Systems Leverage Points
items.fit: Compare possible interventions at different levels of system behavior
items.avoid: Treating any named leverage point as a guaranteed intervention
items.output: Intervention options, risks and evaluation plan

items.title: Scenario Planning
items.fit: Develop multiple coherent alternative futures for strategic uncertainty
items.avoid: Turning scenarios into forecasts or assigning unsupported likelihoods
items.output: Scenario set, critical assumptions and robust action options

items.title: Real Options / Staged Commitment
items.fit: Stage commitments where uncertainty and reversibility have high value
items.avoid: Claiming valuation precision without a defensible model
items.output: Decision stages, exercise/abandon triggers, costs of waiting

items.title: Venture Diligence
items.fit: Evaluate evidence, economics, founder/team, legal and implementation risks
items.avoid: Scoring an incomplete venture as investable based on narrative quality
items.output: Open diligence issues, scenarios and investment memo

items.title: Market Sizing / TAM SAM SOM
items.fit: Establish a defined market boundary and plausible accessible share
items.avoid: Confusing worldwide spend, addressable buyer budget and obtainable revenue
items.output: Triangulated ranges, assumptions and sensitivity

items.title: Market and User Segmentation
items.fit: Differentiate behaviors, constraints and economic attractiveness across segments
items.avoid: Fabricating personas from stereotypes without qualitative/quantitative input
items.output: Versioned segments, uncertainty and target hypotheses

items.title: Competitive Analysis
items.fit: Compare direct, indirect and substitute choices with verified evidence
items.avoid: Assuming competing feature lists explain buying behavior
items.output: Competitor dossiers and differentiated options

items.title: Porter's Five Forces
items.fit: Evaluate industry structure and bargaining economics
items.avoid: Mistaking industry attractiveness for individual company competitiveness
items.output: Industry forces and testable implications

items.title: PESTLE
items.fit: Surface macro-environment dependencies and threats
items.avoid: Treating a long checklist of trends as strategic analysis
items.output: Material external forces and scenarios

items.title: Assumption and Risk Mapping
items.fit: Identify what must be true for an intervention to work and cheapest disconfirming tests
items.avoid: Confusing risk scores with calibrated probabilities
items.output: Ranked assumptions and test backlog

items.title: Pricing Research
items.fit: Choose pricing mechanisms and test willingness to pay
items.avoid: Mistaking volunteered price preference for real purchasing behavior
items.output: Price hypotheses, segments, elasticity caveats and tests

items.title: North Star and Input Metrics
items.fit: Specify meaningful customer value and controllable drivers
items.avoid: Choosing vanity activity counts or confusing correlation with causation
items.output: Metric tree and instrumented definitions

items.title: A/B Experiment Analysis
items.fit: Assess randomized experiments with adequate exposure and controls
items.avoid: Declaring uplift from tiny biased samples or peeking
items.output: Statistical result, uncertainty and decision memo

items.title: Outcome Roadmapping
items.fit: Stage interventions around measurable outcomes rather than feature lists
items.avoid: Treating roadmap dates as contractual promises
items.output: Outcome hypotheses, options, sequencing and review points

items.title: Working Backwards / PRFAQ
items.fit: Stress test customer experience and differentiated value before major delivery
items.avoid: Publishing an invented customer story as validated demand
items.output: PRFAQ draft, outstanding assumptions, release criteria

items.title: Shape Up
items.fit: Define bounded work with clear appetite and explicit unknowns
items.avoid: Applying betting cycles to unbounded exploratory research
items.output: Shaped pitch and time appetite

items.title: Objectives and Key Results
items.fit: Translate strategic objectives into measurable learning and accountability
items.avoid: Top-down activity targets presented as customer outcomes
items.output: Objectives, key results, owners, review rhythm

items.title: Business Capability Mapping
items.fit: Map what an organization must do independently of current org chart
items.avoid: Treating department chart as an operating-capability assessment
items.output: Capability map, dependencies, intervention candidates

items.title: Pre-mortem
items.fit: Surface foreseeable failure modes before high-stakes commitment
items.avoid: Confusing imaginative pessimism with verified risk likelihood
items.output: Failure mechanisms, mitigations, owners and triggers

items.title: Pretotyping / Cheap Validation
items.fit: Find inexpensive tests of desirability before building significant product
items.avoid: Representing fake-door clicks as proven willingness to pay
items.output: Pretotype plan, limitations and evidence

items.title: Design Sprint
items.fit: Rapid collaborative design and concept test with representative customers
items.avoid: Using sprint activities to avoid more basic research or feasibility work
items.output: Prototype, user observations and review actions

items.title: GTM Motion and Beachhead
items.fit: Test acquisition motion and entry segment for a concrete offer
items.avoid: Copying PLG/SLG playbooks regardless of purchasing economics
items.output: Beachhead, ICP, channels, unit economics and experiments

items.title: Venture Portfolio Option Selection
items.fit: Compare ventures, staging, concentration and capital constraints
items.avoid: Letting uncomparable speculative point scores determine allocation
items.output: Thesis-conditioned options and kill/reinvest triggers

items.title: Alternative-first Competitive Positioning
items.fit: Offer or company positioning that requires competitive clarity, buyer fit and market framing
items.avoid: Starting from headline, generic differentiation, invented competitors or no identifiable buyer choice
items.output: Alternatives matrix, differentiated capabilities, buyer value, best-fit segment and category options
